item: Row G's real-source 2019 check is one command, waiting on the environment's network policy (R132)
status: built (fixture-tested); real run waits on the host being allowed
summary: scripts/law_pit_real_run.py fetches one legislation.gov.uk Act's version for a 2019 day and its current version through the ethical fetcher, tracks both with the app's tracker and asks point-in-time search for words only the 2019 text holds; verdict from a closed vocabulary (found, not-found, not-decisive, fetch-refused), refuses without --online or in a non-empty data directory; found needs the words found on the 2019 day and by no version today. Tested on the fixture jurisdiction with a stand-in fetcher. The maintainer allowed the host (R132) but the cloud environment's policy still answers 403, so the real run has not happened and the row stays not-measurable-here.
